title: entry.get, contract version 1
description: Reads one entry as the editor opens it (PRD 5.4, 5.7, 13.4): its type, home node and lifecycle, every variant head with the fields of its draft revision, and its placements with their locales and windows. Every actor may run it; the anonymous principal may not. An entry that is absent or whose home the reader neither reaches nor owns is rejected with entry_not_found. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Entries\Domain\Queries\GetEntry, and the generated codec reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace. Its result is entry.get.result.v1.json.
